entity.description:
When Paris, prince of Troy, carried off queen Helen of Sparta, all the princes of Greece went to war against Troy — including Achilles. During the Trojan War he took captive a beautiful girl, but Agamemnon, leader of the Greek forces, claimed the prisoner, so Achilles withdrew from the fighting. Then Achilles' best friend, Patroclus, went out in his place wearing his armor and the great Trojan champion, Prince Hector, Paris' brother, slew him and took Achilles' armor. So Achilles went back into battle wearing a new armor and avenged his friend, killing many Trojans, including Hector.

Achilles died when the treacherous Paris struck his vulnerable heel with a poisoned arrow.

Known for his bravery, the essence of Achilles bestows great courage upon the super-hero known as Captain Marvel. And in the form of spirit, Achilles is a friend and helper of the young hero Kid Eternity.
